note: By 1.7, the display row has positive mass exactly 1+t. The pinned v- and w-fibers already contribute (1-tau)+(tau+t)=1+t, so every nonactor fiber contributes zero to that row. The actor transverse moment is -A a(tau+t)+At=0 by 1.2. Hence the total transverse moment is actually zero, and therefore is at most C tau for any absolute C, in particular C=64, uniformly in A and I.
